correctness.rationale: Bidiagonal singular value identity and exact M=(I+S)D factorization verified algebraically; generalized discrete string has Green inverse min(i,j), confirmed by a separate 7-site exact-matrix test. Empirical atomic measures converge in Lip operator norm using summation-by-parts; their discrepancy is O_P(N^-1/2). Isolated principal continuum eigenpair solves mixed Dirichlet–Neumann ODE; first-variation coefficient is exact. Bounded triangular-array Lindeberg CLT and delta method yield variance 3π² Var(J^-2)/(32 E[J^-2]^3). The independent finite simulation agrees to sampling precision; simulation is not the proof. Assumptions include endpoint h_N=1, bounded iid disorder, nonparity-constrained gap.

value.rationale: Balanced local disorder preserves the clean critical dynamic exponent z=1, but that exponent does not determine either the physical finite-size gap coefficient or its sample-to-sample uncertainty. The explicit inverse-square-coupling effective velocity and variance resolve these motivated, nontrivial spectral properties for a natural s=0 correlated Ising model; the distinction matters for gap estimation and disorder sample variability, beyond a routine table or arbitrary finite-size computation. The exact transformation and weighted-mode correction are structural and reproducible.
